summary: Answered all four of the owner's open notes with fixes: props stay on screen under board cards, a real city skyline prop, the disclaimer small at the bottom, and slower, fuller long videos. Reverted the title experiment and started a topic-mix experiment for the 'same category' note.
why: Owner notes come first (4 open). The evaluator says REVERT for title-names-the-moment (-9% average % viewed, 87% confidence, 7 vs 7). The owner's topic note matches research's you-in-the-core-story proposal, and no running experiment is in the script area.

findings.title: title-names-the-moment: revert
findings.detail: -9% average % viewed, 87% confidence it is worse (on 7, off 7).

findings.title: What works in Shorts (48 h views vs median)
findings.detail: how_they_make_money 6.5x, secret_of_rich 6.2x, cinematic music 10.2x, 25-29 s 5.7x, narrator 0-24% of words 4.3x (n=12); myth hooks 0.11x (n=5), forest palette 0.11x.

findings.title: Why v-20261104-02 had 17 s of words only
findings.detail: On a board card (no cast) every panel (person card, documents) hid all the beat's props; 5-17 s showed only cards.

findings.title: Topics since 31 Oct
findings.detail: Every Short is a named billionaire or company; the 22-28 Oct 1K week also had the viewer's own money ('Your $20,000 savings' 1,161 views, 'Your Dhanteras necklace' 1,133).

changes.title: Board cards keep their things
changes.detail: A Short's card with one person card or a document of up to 3 rows keeps its props under it (remotion/src/studio/cardshare.ts); checklist rule.

changes.title: Shared city and building props
changes.detail: A skyline of towers with lit windows, roofs and a crane, k = how much is built (remotion/src/studio/places.tsx); checklist: places read as places.

changes.title: Disclaimer at the bottom, small
changes.detail: Minimum text size, slim pill just above the Shorts bottom zone (StoryVideo.tsx).

changes.title: Long videos slower and fuller
changes.detail: Tempo 1.5 -> 1.25 (~180 words a minute); 3-5 things per long beat with an action on every clause; a figure the sum already shows is not slammed in again behind it.

changes.title: Started you-in-the-core-story
changes.detail: Half of Shorts tell a core big-money format through the viewer's own money; judged on 48 h views.
